# Datavant

> Datavant is the healthcare data collaboration platform that securely connects real-world data across 80K+ providers, health plans, life sciences companies, and government agencies.

Datavant enables organizations to access, integrate, and analyze health data while maintaining HIPAA compliance and patient privacy through proprietary technologies like Datavant Connect for patient record linkage. The platform serves diverse healthcare stakeholders including providers, health plans, pharmaceutical companies, medical device manufacturers, and research institutions.

## Key Topics

- Real-World Data (RWD)
- HIPAA Compliance
- Patient Record Linkage
- Data Connectivity
- Health Data Exchange
- Release of Information (ROI)
- Medical Record Retrieval
- EHR Integration
- HEDIS & Star Ratings
- Revenue Cycle Management
- Denials Management
- Clinical Research Data
- Health Data Analytics
- Patient Privacy
- Data Logistics

## Platform Overview

- [Datavant | The Data Collaboration Platform Trusted for Healthcare](https://www.datavant.com): Datavant's healthcare data collaboration platform serving 80K+ providers

## Solutions by Customer Type

- [Solutions for Healthcare Providers](https://www.datavant.com/who-we-serve/healthcare-providers): Datavant solutions for providers: ROI, revenue cycle, denials management
- [Solutions for Health Plans](https://www.datavant.com/who-we-serve/health-plans): Datavant solutions for health plans: HEDIS, Star ratings, risk adjustment
- [Solutions for Clinical R&D](https://www.datavant.com/who-we-serve/clinical-research-development): Datavant Trials: connecting clinical and real-world data for R&D success
- [Solutions for Life Sciences](https://www.datavant.com/who-we-serve/life-sciences): Real-world data connectivity for pharmaceutical and medical device trials
- [Solutions for Commercial Pharma](https://www.datavant.com/who-we-serve/commercial-pharma): Connect proprietary and real-world data for pharma commercial growth
- [Solutions for Medical Devices](https://www.datavant.com/who-we-serve/medical-devices): Real-world data solutions for medical device post-market surveillance
- [Solutions for Health Data & Analytics](https://www.datavant.com/who-we-serve/health-data-analytics): Enterprise health data analytics powered by real-world data ecosystem
- [Solutions for Government](https://www.datavant.com/who-we-serve/government): Privacy-preserving record linkage for government health data initiatives
- [Solutions for Medical Specialty Societies](https://www.datavant.com/who-we-serve/medical-specialty-societies): Registry expansion and real-world data connectivity for specialty societies
- [Solutions for Health Data & Analytics (Legal & Insurance)](https://www.datavant.com/who-we-serve/legal-and-insurance): ChartSwap for legal, insurance, and litigation support with real-world data

## Specialized Solutions

- [Solutions for Health Information Management](https://www.datavant.com/who-we-serve/health-information-management): Release of information and ROI workflow solutions for HIM departments
- [Solutions for Revenue Cycle Management](https://www.datavant.com/who-we-serve/revenue-cycle-management): HIM coding, denials management, and healthcare audit solutions
- [Powerful Data Logistic Solutions for Health Plans](https://www.datavant.com/product-sheet/powerful-data-logistic-solutions-health-plans): Data logistics solutions for health plans enabling HEDIS optimization
